title: Quenched, Soft Thai Udon Noodles Khao Pad
description: A rich, buttery, and gooey Thai-inspired solo-dinner dish featuring udon noodles.
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the sashimi-grade cod and cook until opaque, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and the sliced green onions.
Stir-fry the green onions for 1 minute, until slightly softened.
Add the bean sprouts, grated ginger, and a pinch of salt. Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the bean sprouts are tender.
In a small saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over low heat.
Add the fish sauce and stir until combined.
Pour the butter sauce over the cooked noodles and toss to coat.
Return the cooked cod to the skillet and toss to combine.
Garnish with additional green onions and sliced fresh chilies, if desired.
